items.title: Tesla must prove Cybercab is legal to sell, NHTSA says
items.summary: Tesla now has to prove to government regulators that its Cybercab — which has no steering wheel or pedals — is legal to sell, and safe for the road.

items.title: How worried should software, semiconductor stocks be about AI risks?
items.summary: SK hynix (SKHY) is reportedly in talks with Intel (INTC) to use the latter's facilities to manufacture memory chips in the US for the first time, according to Reuters. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by RBC Capital Markets head of derivatives strategy Amy Wu Silverman to examine how the software industry is reacting to AI headlines, comparing it to the internet booms of the past.

items.title: Amazon Deal Sends Generac Stock Skyrocketing
items.summary: Generac will supply backup power generators for Amazon data centers in a long-term deal. Amazon also will get warrants to buy Generac stock.

items.title: TTD Stock In Focus: Morningstar Sees Market Share Shrinking As Amazon, Google And Meta Ramp Up Ad Competition
items.summary: Morningstar says Amazon’s advertising platform and other data-heavy rivals could put pressure on The Trade Desk.

items.title: The World Isn’t Ready for an Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Anthropic could be public in a matter of weeks. Wall Street—and the world—are nowhere near prepared for what’s to come.

items.title: What Has Home Depot Stopped Telling You About Where Its Goods Come From?
items.summary: Home Depot (HD) stock has lost about a quarter of its value over the past year, while the S&P 500 gained close to 17%. Where the goods on its shelves come from used to be something management explained at length. Now you mostly hear how fast they arrive.

items.title: The Next Short? Economist Compares Hyperscaler AI Debt Stress to 2008 Housing Collapse
items.summary: Apollo's Torsten Slok warns hyperscaler debt risk mirrors 2008 housing crisis signals as CDS spreads widen sharply.

items.title: Generac Stock Soars on Amazon Generator Deal
items.summary: The backup power company disclosed a long-term deal to provide Amazon generators for its data centers.
